evidence: The three metal precursors, La(thd)3, Sr(thd)2 and Co(acac)3, were first tested separately to search for the optimal pulsing lengths for the precursor and the ozone gas. The test depositions were carried out at 290 °C, selected for being a typical deposition temperature in the case of β-diketonate precursors and for yielding visually non-gradient films over the entire substrate surface. ... The N2 purges after the precursor and ozone pulses were kept at 1.5 s and 2.5 s, respectively.
